title:
Comment of Glenda Smith in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15423-000
Submission Date: 11/3/2026

documents.name: 152264.txt
documents.text:
Glenda Smith, Wasilla, AK.
I would like to go on record opposing a permit for an underwater data center in Cook Inlet.  I think there could be considerable impact to the whale migration and other marine life in our waters.  PLEASE require environmental information that would show no impact prior to any underwater development -- I don't believe that exists and I don't think killing our planet for AI is of benefit to humans or animals.

Thank you.
